groups.title: D16 — formatRange drops O and long zone-name widths (ICU-20548)
groups.trigger: an ICU release that fixes ICU-20548 is bundled by GMT's engines.node floor (>=22.16.0) and by every browser the native suite runs, so every D16 repro passes on every engine: this check reports Node, and the weekly run's compat check in each browser (the temporal-compat-chromium, -firefox and -webkit verdicts) reports the rest; D16 is removable only when all of them say so

groups.title: D17 — formatRange writes AM/PM for a flexible dayPeriod next to a timeZoneName (SpiderMonkey)
groups.trigger: the weekly run's compat check in Firefox (the temporal-compat-firefox verdict) reports D17 removable: every D17 repro passes in the Firefox the native suite runs, once Bugzilla 2085525 ships. Firefox is the only engine in D17's scope; this check runs on Node, where D17 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D19 — ZonedDateTime#equals answers false for two identifiers of one zone where resolvedOptions keeps the identifier (JavaScriptCore)
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release whose TimeZoneEquals finds the primary identifier on a host whose Intl.DateTimeFormat#resolvedOptions returns the identifier as written, so the D19 probe (Etc/UTC equals UTC, ECMA-402 §6.5) passes in the WebKit the native suite runs: the weekly run's compat check in WebKit (the temporal-compat-webkit verdict) reports it. WebKit is the only engine in D19's scope; this check runs on Node, where D19 is out of scope and never removable

groups.title: D22 — a zoned relativeTo or start in a repeated hour is measured from the wrong instant, so total, round and until in a date unit answer wrongly from the later pass, and wrongly or not at all from the earlier pass when the end falls in the later pass at a lower wall clock; where a TC39 Assert fails no value exists (tc39/proposal-temporal#3336), including after a skipped hour, and GMT returns its sentinel where the polyfill extrapolates
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release on which every D22 repro passes, P7D with largestUnit "week" giving P1W among them, and which gives no value in totalsWithNoValue, noDayCorrection and emptyDaySpan, where TC39 Asserts (tc39/proposal-temporal#3336); if #3336 gives these lengths a value instead, the rows, the throws and the repros change together

groups.title: D9 — an out-of-range non-ISO month amount throws only after work linear in the amount (temporalCompat/monthRange.ts throws first)
groups.trigger: a temporal-polyfill release throws for an out-of-range month amount in bounded time: hebrew 2024-01-15 + 40,000,000 months throws in at most 5,000 ms (an absolute ceiling that fails the repro at once), and + 400,000,000 months throws in under 3 × the time of + 40,000,000 months + 10 ms
